description: ICA于1920年推出的折叠相机。使用120 roll film (some early versions for 117 roll film)。Lever。

specs.胶片/画幅: 120 roll film (some early versions for 117 roll film)
specs.取景器: Collapsible brilliant finder and some versions with Iconometer (wire finder)
specs.英文简介: The Icarette series of cameras were made by ICA from 1912 and are non-self-erecting folding bed cameras for roll film.
